name: mona
description: Mona — a local desktop workbench for Codewhale. Desktop app and shared contracts live in apps/desktop and packages/*; the bootstrap utility stays in tools/build.

scripts.test: vitest run && npm run bootstrap:test && npm run spike:test
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mona/contracts && npm run build -w @mona/adapter && npm run build -w @mona/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @mona/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @mona/adapter && npm run typecheck -w @mona/desktop
scripts.ci: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
